metadata.title: Conditional Uniformization of Kähler Surfaces
metadata.abstract: We prove that a complete noncompact Kähler surface with nonnegative Ricci and nonnegative quadratic orthogonal bisectional curvature is contractible, and hence homeomorphic to $\mathbb{R}^4$, if it is simply connected at infinity. Under positive bisectional curvature, this removes the contractibility assumption from the conditional uniformization theorem of Datar--Pingali--Seshadri: strong Steinness and simple connectivity at infinity suffice to identify the surface biholomorphically with $\mathbb{C}^2$. We also derive bounded-gradient strictly plurisubharmonic exhaustions and uniform holomorphic kernel estimates for complete $U(n)$-invariant Kähler metrics on $\mathbb{C}^n$ with nonnegative bisectional curvature.

analysis.workSummary: 在非负 Ricci 与非负二次正交双截曲率下，证明无穷远单连通的完备非紧 Kähler 曲面可缩且同胚 R⁴；并推进附加条件下的双全纯一致化。
analysis.breakthrough: 在所述条件一致化定理中去掉可缩性作为独立假设。
analysis.limitations: 同胚 R⁴不等于双全纯 C²；后者还需正双截曲率、强 Stein 性等条件，不是一般 Yau 一致化猜想的证明。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确披露 ChatGPT-6 协助发展证明，并称已仔细核验全部论证；声明未细分具体引理贡献。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者明确披露 ChatGPT-6 协助发展证明，并称已仔细核验全部论证；声明未细分具体引理贡献。

analysis.priorityReason: 曲率与拓扑及复几何一致化关系紧密，应优先核对假设。
